about: Every number and claim this lesson shows or says, with its source, re-opened Nov 6, 2026 (00_story/story.md, Receipts). The max-per-lead box screen, the trade names on our report screenshots and the weekly-report habit are ours (EXAMPLE on screen where shown). We never say cost per lead will rise and never name the later wave's date: no source gives either.

move.what: Local Services Ads move into Google Ads as Performance Max campaigns with pay-per-lead goals
move.phase1: August 2026: select home and storefront service advertisers in the United States (including plumbing, HVAC, electrical, appliance repair, house cleaning, lawn care, roofing, pest control, and moving)
move.phase2: late 2026: service-area businesses without physical storefronts and accounts with custom bidding or booking configurations
move.phase3: 2027: non-U.S. accounts and all remaining categories
move.manualBidding: Manual bidding (such as setting a maximum cost-per-lead) is no longer supported in Google Ads.
move.reports: Your Local Services Ads performance reports will not transition to Google Ads.
move.reportsInclude: past impressions, clicks, weekly spend, ad-level reports
move.download: You'll be able to download your historical reports soon on the redirection page.
move.screenshots: If you need your reports immediately, please take screenshots of them before migrating.
move.leadsMove: lead history automatically transfers to Google Ads and remains accessible within the new Leads page
move.payPerLead: You only pay for valid, qualified leads (such as phone calls, message leads, or bookings)
move.notice: The account administrator listed on your profile will receive an advance notification email 14 days before your migration date, plus warning banners in the current dashboard; a final reminder 7 days later; one after migration
move.title: Local Services Ads moving into Google Ads

liaison.what: Google's Ads Product Liaison: no action will be needed by advertisers beyond downloading historical reports; Google strongly recommends all advertisers download their historical data ahead of their transition timing
